title: Fabulous! Just enough!
text: Very historically interesting. Take water. You will be so engrossed you won’t realise where 5hrs have gone!
author: Kaely_B

title: Comprehensive Walking Tour Of Seville!
text:
Such an amazing introduction to Seville!  If you are short on time, I highly recommend this tour.  We purchased the tickets for the Cathedral and the Alcazar online beforehand and started the tour with visits to these 2 amazing monuments!
Susana is amazing!  She is a veritable treasure trove of knowledge but her warm and friendly personality shines above it all!  After touring the monuments, we walked through the Jewish neighborhood, stopped for ice cream en route, and then proceeded to walk to other parts of the town.  We even took 2 taxis to reach the last few spots because we were very tire
author: Ruby_K

title: Strolling through history.
text:
We did a great tour that included visiting the Jewish Quarter, the cigarette factory that is now the university and the Alcazar. Our tour guide was very passionate and knowledgeable and explained to us the origins of Don Juan and Carmen and how these two fictious persons later on became stereotypes. Our tour guide was lively, humorous and engaging and before we knew it the tour was over.
 We enjoyed the tour a great deal and can highly recommend it.
author: Dianne_M

title: Jorge--Best tour guide imaginable
text: I have gone with many tour directors on my travels, and Jorge was the best of them all. Not only was he knowledgeable about Sevilla, his love and respect for his city was palpable. He was so eager to share his knowledge with my group( all 8 of us!) but he was never condescending or snooty about the knowledge he had about his beloved city. He regaled us with stories as an extra in the movie "Kingdom of God" , and showed us vantage points where Game of Thrones was shot using Alcazar as the Kingdom of Dorne in GOT. Since he grew up in Seville, he knew its secrets and he was so eager to share them
author: Elizabeth_A

title: An Excellent Way to See Seville
text: This private tour was an excellent way to see all of the city's highlights.  Elena, our tour guide, was perfect in providing us with just the right amount of information on the various sights we saw.  She was attentive to our needs and flexible in adjusting the itinerary according to our interests.  It was nicely paced.
author: CAS0924

title: Beautiful city with great professional guided tour by Susana Perez
text:
We have been to Seville with my family and friends for the first time. The city is beautiful. The tour was conducted in German by Susana Perez. She speaks fluent German and is very professional. She gave us a lot of information. She told and showed us a lot about the city.  We visited the palace " Real Alcazar" with the guide. .... a dream...I personally liked it more than the palaces in Alhambra. 
It was unforgettable and can only be recommended.
author: MStavros84

title: Private Tour of Seville
text: Jorge was an excellent guide. He was extremely knowledgeable and passionate about Seville.  He made our visit rich, enjoyable and educational.
author: frankatz12017
